verdict.rationale: Skyvern serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json covering run endpoints such as POST /v1/run/tasks. Its API reference and live playground are generated from that spec, and its deprecation policy commits to marking `deprecated: true` in the spec. The probe's 404s were on skyvern.com paths, a different host, so they don't contradict the api.skyvern.com document. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec at api.skyvern.com downloads and is complete.
